evidence:
Frozen task .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r12/task (input 2996e34d...). Paths named by the brief: instruction.md:11 names /instructions/hireops_rules.md and /instructions/integration.md; instruction.md:13 names /assets/seed_data.json. All three exist under environment/ (environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md, environment/instructions/integration.md, environment/assets/seed_data.json). environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile and carries 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/', 'COPY assets/ /assets/' and 'chmod -R a+rX /instructions /assets'; task.toml:2 artifacts = ["/app", "/assets"]. seed_data.json parses (keys: stages, candidate_status_labels, thread_page_size, users 10, jobs 3, applications 16, messages 127, notes 3, reads 6).
Content vs prompt/rules: the 10 users' emails and roles match instruction.md:17 exactly (3 recruiters, 3 hiring managers, 1 observer, 3 candidates). stages APPLIED..REJECTED match hireops_rules.md:42-43; candidate_status_labels match the wording table rules:183-190 verbatim; thread_page_size 30 matches rules:144 and rules:209 ('The candidate wording and the page size of 30 are in the same file'); 'three jobs ... one conversation is long ... a few internal notes and read markers' (rules:206-208) holds (APP-101 has 120 messages, others 3/3/1). interview_limit values 3/2/3 are within 1-50 and no seeded job is over its limit (PLAT 2/3, DATA 1/2, DSGN 1/3). Positions are contiguous 1..n per job/stage. The one rejected card (APP-301) carries rejected_from SCREEN and a non-blank reason per rules:49-51. All sender/author/reader/application/job/manager/recruiter ids resolve; messages are chronological per conversation with no duplicate timestamps. Note authors are recruiters or that job's own manager. The rules example 'Mei Lin moved Priya Nair from Screen to Interview' (rules:111) is consistent with seed (Priya Nair APP-103 in PLAT Screen; Mei Lin a recruiter).
Content vs judges: tests/app_context.md:29-31 '120 messages at the start' = seed. functional prompt.md:25 / judge.toml:344 'Lena Fischer starts with 1 unread': APP-301 messages REC3, CAN3, REC3 with Lena read_count 2 -> exactly 1 unread from another sender under either count-based or id-based reading. functional judge.toml:416 seeded Platform Engineer order (Applied: Greta Lindqvist, Ade Bello, Marco Rossi; Screen: Priya Nair, Samuel Ortiz) matches seed positions; 'Noor Haddad's seeded internal note' exists (APP-101, by Ingrid, the PLAT manager). prompt.md:39 fallback 'his seeded Data Analyst conversation' = APP-201 (Tomas, JOB-DATA). Polish rows on Noor's Platform Engineer conversation: Rafael read_count 120 => starts at 0 unread, so the scrolled-up/new-message rows start from a clean baseline. Visual/polish 'Noor Haddad's long conversation' exists. Candidate rows: Noor owns APP-101+APP-302, Tomas APP-201, Lena APP-301, linked by candidate_email = account email (rules:35-36).
Content vs solution: solution/app/src/seed_data.json is byte-identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json (both sha256 a1c65c806b54da99a37ab2b5f455ede0a9385a09569903fb3a7f3446f7e83740, also the hash pinned in raw-evidence-index for the golden run). solution/app/src/db.js:10 loads it relative to __dirname (rules:198-201) and consumes exactly the shipped fields (candidate_status_labels, thread_page_size, interview_limit, rejected_from, reject_reason, read_count mapped to message id, candidate_email linking at db.js:70-74); seeding is once-only (db.js:62). Raw evidence qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-03-workspace/results/workspace.json (sha256 7ae5b5c3... verified, matches index) records a 'seeded card order and internal notes are loaded' group, scripted golden only, not a judge run.
Adversarial: (a) broken app reading /assets/seed_data.json at runtime: the brief (instruction.md:15) states /assets is unavailable at runtime, so failing it is fair and announced; (b) conforming alternative that orders messages by array index or by created_at, or treats read_count as count of messages: all yield the same orders and unread values because per-conversation arrays are chronological with distinct timestamps; (c) app that seeds the password from the brief: seed has no password field and the brief/rules both give Hireops!2026, consistent. No mismatch found that would let a wrong app pass or a conforming app fail because of the assets.
Out-of-row observation (not a row-13 defect): environment/instructions/integration.md adds a 5-line 'For delivery, use ordinary files under /app. Symbolic links ...' paragraph beyond the frozen template's integration.md; its content is consistent with the brief and seed, so it does not affect assets matching; template-preservation is for the owning row(s).
Not exercised by me: no Docker build or container run (not authorized for this read-only review); COPY reliance is established by identical-to-template Dockerfile plus the recorded verifier-image golden run, not by a build I ran.
